d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

Set in a secluded cove at Bandar Jissah, between the Al Hajar Mountains and the Gulf of Oman, Jumeirah Muscat Bay invites guests to experience Muscat’s breathtaking natural beauty, where mountains meet the sea at the resort’s edge. The resort offers ocean-facing rooms and suites, as well as summerhouses and villas with private plunge pools and direct beach access. Guests can also enjoy Jumeirah’s signature Talise Spa, an SSI-certified dive centre, diverse dining options, and a dedicated Kids Club.

d: We are currently seeking a dynamic, passionate, and self-motivated Food & Beverage professional to join our team as a Head Waitress, with a strong focus on bar and beverage service.

In this role, you will support the day-to-day supervision of the bar service team, ensuring smooth operations and consistently high service standards. You will combine strong beverage knowledge with engaging, personalized service to create a memorable and vibrant experience for our guests.
As a Head Waitress, you will lead by example, support and motivate the team, and contribute to the overall atmosphere and commercial success of the outlet.
q: You should ideally have a diploma or relevant qualification in Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage, or a related field, with previous experience in a bar, lounge, nightlife venue, hotel, or high-volume Food & Beverage operation.
Fluency in written and spoken English is essential, while knowledge of additional languages would be an advantage. Good working knowledge of MICROS or a similar POS system is desirable.

Previous experience in a supervisory or team-leadership role within a bar or beverage operation is highly preferred. You should have good knowledge of beverages, wines, spirits, cocktails, bar service standards, and upselling techniques, with the confidence to make recommendations according to guest preferences.
The ideal candidate will be well-presented, confident, outgoing, and guest-focused, with a genuine passion for bar service and creating memorable guest experiences.

You should be hands-on, proactive, energetic, and approachable, with the ability to lead and motivate the service team while maintaining high operational and service standards. You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced and vibrant bar environment, particularly during busy evenings, weekends, events, and promotional nights.
You should also demonstrate the following competencies

Full Up is seeking a motivated and results-driven B2B Business Development & Sales Specialist with excellent communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills to join our team and contribute to expanding our network of service providers and acquiring new corporate clients.

During the initial phase, the role will primarily focus on outbound telephone sales, reaching out to potential service providers, introducing Full Up's solutions and competitive advantages, encouraging them to join the platform, and following up on registration and contractual procedures.

In subsequent phases, responsibilities will expand to contacting businesses and organizations, presenting Full Up's vehicle service and expense management solutions, and acquiring new corporate customers and subscriptions.
Conduct outbound calls to potential service providers and encourage them to join the Full Up platform.
Target fuel stations and automotive service centers, including engine oil, tire, battery, car wash, and car care providers.
Deliver professional presentations highlighting the platform's services, commercial advantages, and operational benefits.
Explain the onboarding process, registration requirements, and available services for providers.
Present key platform features, including order management, financial reporting, automated settlements, and technology-driven solutions.
Negotiate with prospective partners, respond to inquiries, and effectively handle objections.
Follow up on partnership applications and coordinate with relevant departments to complete registration and contractual procedures.
Contact prospective companies and organizations through outbound calls to introduce Full Up's services and solutions.
Present vehicle service management and expense management solutions for corporate fleets.
Identify customer needs and recommend suitable services and subscription packages.
Acquire new corporate clients and contribute to subscription growth and sales performance.
Prepare commercial proposals and follow up with prospective customers through the subscription or contracting process.
Establish and maintain long-term professional relationships with corporate clients.
Execute outbound sales calls according to established acquisition plans and sales strategies.
Research potential customers and build targeted lists of companies and service providers.
Maintain accurate customer records and update sales pipeline stages using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.
Conduct regular follow-ups and convert qualified leads into successful partnerships and contracts.
Achieve assigned sales targets, acquisition goals, and performance indicators.
Prepare periodic reports on outbound calls, business opportunities, and sales results.
Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure a smooth onboarding process and a positive customer experience.
1–3 years of practical experience in telesales, business development, or B2B sales.

Full Up provides a comprehensive training and onboarding program for successful candidates, including:
Introduction to Full Up's platform, services, and technology solutions.
Training on service provider acquisition and corporate customer onboarding.
Practical training on platform systems and CRM tools.
Training in outbound sales techniques and professional sales presentations.
Development of persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.
Training on registration procedures, contractual processes, and customer follow-up.
Understanding sales performance indicators and strategies for achieving assigned targets.
Previous experience with Full Up systems is not required, as comprehensive training will be provided.
At Full Up, we place great importance on practical skills, communication abilities, persuasion, and the capacity to deliver measurable results rather than years of experience alone.
Priority will be given to candidates who demonstrate excellent verbal fluency, confidence, and professional communication skills.
The ability to establish business relationships and persuade prospective customers is a key selection criterion.
We welcome ambitious and self-motivated candidates who demonstrate initiative and a strong willingness to develop their professional skills.
The recruitment process may include a simulated sales call to assess communication, persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Full Up provides a professional, mixed-gender work environment for both men and women, promoting collaboration, teamwork, equal opportunities, and continuous professional development.
